story.title: The Wolf-Dragonfly Of The Toxic Swamps
story.signature_move: It hovers above the water before darting sideways in a blink to snatch a swamp rat with its hooked legs.
story.hybrid_look: It features a long jewel-blue segmented body and huge eyes on a wolf-shaped head, supported by six thin hooked legs and insect wings, ending in a thick wolf-like brush tail with shining glassy armour mixed with fur.

sentences.text: This impossible monster rips through toxic air with zero warning.
